{{Youmay|[[The Force/Legends|the Force]]-imbued [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]]|the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] [[The Heart of the Universe|adventure]]}}
The '''Heart of the Universe''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-imbued gem that was created by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jaled Dur]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The gem contained great power and by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] had fallen into the possession of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Croym]], who kept it in his tower, on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
